media_description: Two synthetic slides, a provided aligned transcript, tones, and one exact silence interval.
limitations: The fixture is synthetic and is not a sample of real classroom conditions.
The transcript is provided; ASR accuracy is not measured.
The audio uses tones plus silence, so speech/audio semantic correspondence is not measured.
Classroom observations are provided annotations and are excluded from detector metrics.
Passing this fixture does not establish real-world event accuracy or learning gains.
